LanguageData.TribalTrophies_Settings_Trophies_Ceremon: If enabled, a trophy is locked by default once a colonist is adorned with it, and cannot be removed. This can be toggled per trophy on the Trophies tab. This setting does not affect biocoding. Default: ON
Prompt for a Tale of Honor during ceremonies

If enabled, a dialog will appear during adorning ceremonies to enter a Tale of Honor for the trophy, if it does not have one yet. If disabled, no dialog will appear, but a Tale of Honor can still be written before the ceremony starts. Default: ON
If enabled, a Tale of Honor will be suggested when the dialog opens and none has been written yet. Default: OFF
If enabled, trophies can have a dynamic effect on traits such as gaining the elder trait or losing wimp when adorned. A ceremony changes at most one trait. Default: ON
LanguageData.TribalTrophies_Settings_Trophies_Npc_Gen: Pawns from other factions can spawn already adorned with trophies. Existing pawns are not changed. Default: ON
LanguageData.TribalTrophies_Settings_Trophies_Npc_Npc: Lowest tech level of factions whose pawns can spawn with trophies. Default: Animal
Highest tech level of factions whose pawns can spawn with trophies. Default: Medieval
LanguageData.TribalTrophies_Settings_Scalping_Ui_Show: Pawns and corpses will have a gizmo to order colonists to scalp them. Scalping is still available from the right-click menu and the Orders menu. Default: ON
LanguageData.TribalTrophies_Settings_Scalping_MentalB: Scalping mental breaks can target children
The scalping frenzy and prisoner scalping mental breaks can target children and babies. Default: OFF
LanguageData.TribalTrophies_Settings_Scalping_Npc_Gen: Pawns from other factions can spawn with an old scalping scar. Chance is 5% for animal-level factions and falls linearly to 0% for spacer-level and higher. Default: ON
Pawns can spawn with scalp belts
Pawns from other factions whose ideoligion allows scalping can spawn wearing a scalp belt. More common in low-tech and merciless factions. Default: ON
Pawns can spawn with skull belts
Pawns from other factions whose ideoligion desires skullspikes can spawn wearing a skull belt. More common in low-tech factions. Default: ON
LanguageData.TribalTrophies_Settings_Scalping_Npc_Sca: Scalp poles spawn in other factions' settlements
Settlements of factions whose ideoligion allows scalping and whose tech level is Medieval or lower can generate with scalp poles and some scalps. Default: ON
LanguageData.TribalTrophies_Settings_Scalping_ScalpHu: Some raids by factions whose ideoligion allows scalping come to take scalps from downed or dead colonists. They leave once they have taken enough scalps. Default: ON
Highest tech level of factions that can send scalp hunts. Default: Industrial
Scalp hunters can arrive by drop pod
If enabled, scalp hunts by factions able to use drop pods can arrive by drop pod. Default: ON
LanguageData.TribalTrophies_Settings_Scalping_ScalpRe: Factions whose ideoligion allows scalping can ask for scalps of their enemies. Default: ON
Highest tech level of factions that can ask for scalps. Default: Industrial
Only settlements closer than this to your colony can ask for scalps. If you have a gravship, this limit does not apply. Default: 32
LanguageData.TribalTrophies_Settings_Display_Renderin: If enabled, worn trophies will be drawn on pawns. Default: ON
LanguageData.TribalTrophies_Settings_Display_Worn_Tro: Size of trophies drawn on pawns. Default: 130%
LanguageData.TribalTrophies_Settings_Display_Worn_Fan: Controls how much feathers fan out. 0% - straight up, 100% - fanned out. Default: 35%
LanguageData.TribalTrophies_Settings_Display_Worn_Ver: Moves trophies higher or lower. Default: 0.1
LanguageData.TribalTrophies_Settings_Display_Worn_Max: Number of trophies drawn on a pawn. Trophies over this count are still worn, but not drawn. Default: 9
